Nice to meet you properly. I'm Segun Babajide, the founder of Real Estate Matchmakers.

I spent years in IT, risk and audit, where the first rule is simple: check before you trust. I run this business the same way. Every home and plot we show you has had its title, survey and price checked first.

We work across Lagos and Abuja, with buyers at home and abroad. Tell me what you're looking for and I'll find the right match.

#RealEstateMatchmakers #MeetTheFounder #LagosRealEstate #AbujaRealEstate #PropertyInNigeria

I've heard too many stories of people who paid for land that was sold twice, or a house with papers that turned out to be fake.

That's why I'd rather lose a sale than show you something I haven't checked. Buying property should be the best decision you make, not the one you regret.

#RealEstateMatchmakers #VerifiedProperty #PropertyInNigeria #LagosRealEstate #AbujaRealEstate

Ask me anything about buying property in Lagos or Abuja.

Titles, prices, areas, payment plans, buying from abroad, how to spot fake documents. Drop your question in the comments and I'll answer every one this week.

No question is too basic.

#AskMeAnything #RealEstateMatchmakers #LagosRealEstate #AbujaRealEstate #NigeriansInDiaspora

Before real estate, my world was IT, risk and audit. In that world you don't take anything on trust. You check it, you document it, and you check it again.

I bring that same habit to property. Title, registry search, survey, site visit, clean paperwork. Every time.

That's what "We check it before you buy it" means.

#RealEstateMatchmakers #VerifiedProperty #PropertyInNigeria

Season's greetings from all of us at Real Estate Matchmakers.

Thank you to everyone who trusted us this year, asked questions, came for inspections and shared our posts. Here's to new keys and new homes in 2027.
